profile.headline: Web & Software Engineering | AI-Integrated Systems | Scalable Cloud Architecture with Node.js, Go, AWS & Next.js | Performance & Reliability
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with a strong foundation in full-stack development, cloud architecture, and performance optimization across diverse platforms. Proven expertise in deploying scalable applications using Go, AWS Lambda, and Next.js, with a track record of enhancing system performance, reducing latency, and accelerating feature delivery. Adept at leading complex migrations, integrating advanced monitoring solutions like Datadog, and driving cross-functional collaboration to align software initiatives with business goals. Skilled in a wide array of technologies including Node.js, Python, React, and AWS, with a deep commitment to writing clean, maintainable code and delivering secure, user-centric solutions.
